mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, virtual_qty, virtual_usable_qty, virtual_frozen_qty, back_avg_inventory_age, avg_inventory_age, is_diff, frozen_qty, frozen_is_diff, date
mapper.select: WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select max(vidh.date) as date, max(vidh.update_time) as updateTime, vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as backInventoryAgeQty, sum(vidh.qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vidh.date = #{date} group by vid.sku_id,vid.warehouse_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT max(vih.date) as date, vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vih.date = #{date} GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ),CombinedProcessing AS ( SELECT sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(frozen_qty) AS frozenQty FROM ( SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM first_mile_processing WHERE is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM so_b2b_processing WHERE is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM so_b2c_processing WHERE is_deleted = false ) AS combined GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.date as date, vidh.sku_id as skuId, vidh.warehouse_id as warehouseId, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vidh.updateTime, vih.virtualQty, vih.virtualUsableQty, vih.virtualFrozenQty, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(vidh.inventoryAgeQty * 1.0 / vih.virtualQty,4) end as avgInventoryAge, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(vidh.backInventoryAgeQty / vih.virtualQty,4) end as backAvgInventoryAge, COALESCE(cp.frozenQty,0) as frozenQty, case when vih.virtualFrozenQty = COALESCE(cp.frozenQty,0) then false else true end as frozenIsDiff from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = vih.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join CombinedProcessing cp on vidh.sku_id = cp.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = cp.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = cp.virtual_warehouse_id

select vtfd.bill_date as billDate, vtf.source_type as sourceType, vtf.source_code as sourceCode, vhd.batch_no as batchNo, vtf.operation_mode as operationMode, vtf.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, vtf.dict_inventory_status as dictInventoryStatus, vtfd.qty, vtfd.cur_inventory_qty as curInventoryQty, vtf.org_id as orgId, vtf.warehouse_id as warehouseId, vtf.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vtf.transaction_no as transactionNo, wh.name as warehouseName, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName from virtual_trans_flow_detail vtfd inner join virtual_inventory_detail vhd on vtfd.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vhd.id and vhd.is_deleted = false inner join virtual_trans_flow vtf on vtfd.virtual_trans_flow_id = vtf.id and vtf.is_deleted = false left join product_detail pd on vhd.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vtf.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vtf.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} and vtfd.is_deleted = false and vhd.sku_id = #{params.skuId} and vhd.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId} and vhd.virtual_warehouse_id = #{params.virtualWarehouseId} and vhd.batch_no = #{params.batchNo} order by
${item.field} ${item.sort}
vhd.batch_no desc
